revert_tooltip: Hold to revert to default settings.
customization_glow_disabled_tooltip: Enable visual effects to change glow color.
customization_keybind_editor_tooltip: To cancel editing, press the escape key. To clear/revert to default, hold the edit button/option name.
game_settings_ball_speed_tooltip: Controls the initial speed of the ball.
game_settings_max_score_tooltip: Minimum score required to win the game.
game_settings_tiebreaker_tooltip: In order to win, a player has to have at least 2 more points than their opponent.
game_settings_obstacle_tooltip: Adds a moving obstacle in the middle of the playing field.
game_settings_combo_tooltip: Combo points are gained whenever you hit the ball. When your combo gets high enough, you will score bonus points if you win the round.
game_settings_combo_disabled_tooltip: Enable the combo bonus setting to edit this setting.
game_settings_combo_hits_tooltip: Minimum number of combo points required to earn one bonus point.
game_settings_combo_max_tooltip: Maximum number of bonus points you can earn.
game_settings_chaos_mode_tooltip: Every time the ball hits a player's paddle it gets faster. Good luck.
settings_show_visual_effects_tooltip: Show glow effects, impact sparks etc.
